text.title: Episode Recap: The Missing Painting
paragraphs: In last night's episode of Harbor Town, a famous painting disappeared from the city museum. Detective Kim Park started the [[investigation]] right away.
At nine o'clock, the museum guard was watching the cameras, but he didn't see anything strange. While he was drinking his coffee, the lights suddenly [[went out]].
Kim talked to everybody. At the time of the [[theft]], the director was having dinner with a friend, and the two cleaners were working on the second floor. Everybody had an [[alibi]].
Then Kim noticed something. When the lights went out, it was raining hard, but the guard's shoes were completely dry. He wasn't sitting in his office: he was [[hiding]] the painting in his car!
The episode ended with a [[cliffhanger]]: while Kim was arresting the guard, someone was watching her from a black car.

went out.note: to go out → went out = apagar (luz, fogo)

cliffhanger.note: O final que deixa você querendo ver o próximo episódio.

grammar.title: Past continuous: o que estava acontecendo
explanation: O past continuous mostra uma ação em andamento num momento do passado. É o nosso "estava fazendo": At nine o'clock, the guard was watching the cameras (às nove horas, o guarda estava olhando as câmeras).
A forma é was ou were + o verbo com -ing. I, he, she e it usam was; you, we e they usam were: the director was having dinner, the cleaners were working.

Ele aparece muito em histórias e resumos de séries, para descrever o cenário: it was raining hard. E combina com o past simple: uma ação longa, em andamento (past continuous), é interrompida por uma ação curta (past simple). While he was drinking his coffee, the lights went out.
Normalmente, while vem com a ação longa (while he was drinking) e when com a ação curta (when the lights went out).
Na negativa: wasn't ou weren't + -ing (he wasn't sitting in his office). Na pergunta: Was he sitting in his office? Were they working?

examples.en: The guard was watching the cameras.
examples.pt: O guarda estava olhando as câmeras.

examples.en: While he was drinking his coffee, the lights went out.
examples.pt: Enquanto ele estava tomando café, as luzes apagaram.

examples.en: When the lights went out, it was raining hard.
examples.pt: Quando as luzes apagaram, estava chovendo forte.

examples.en: He wasn't sitting in his office.
examples.pt: Ele não estava sentado no escritório.

exercises.explanation: O texto diz: "a famous painting disappeared from the city museum".

exercises.statement: The director was having dinner at the time of the theft.
exercises.explanation: Verdadeiro: "the director was having dinner with a friend".

exercises.prompt: O que a Kim percebeu sobre o guarda?
exercises.explanation: Estava chovendo forte, mas "the guard's shoes were completely dry": ele não estava no escritório.

exercises.statement: It was raining when the lights went out.
exercises.explanation: Verdadeiro: "When the lights went out, it was raining hard".

exercises.sentence: At nine o'clock, the guard ___ the cameras.
exercises.explanation: Ação em andamento num momento do passado: was + watching.

exercises.sentence: The two cleaners ___ working on the second floor.
exercises.explanation: The two cleaners está no plural (they), então usamos were.

exercises.sentence: While he was drinking his coffee, the lights suddenly ___ out.
exercises.explanation: A ação curta que interrompe a outra fica no past simple: the lights went out.

options: When the phone rang, I was taking a shower.
When the phone rang, I taking a shower.
When the phone ringing, I was take a shower.
exercises.explanation: Ação curta no past simple (rang) e ação longa no past continuous (was taking).

exercises.prompt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
exercises.explanation: Sujeito + was + verbo com -ing + complemento: Someone was watching her from a black car.
